principle: Bottom-up: segment population x usage/penetration x price. Every input is either 'sourced' (with URL + retrievedAt) or 'assumption' (with rationale). Third-party market-size headlines are context only.

us_domestic_person_trips_2025.note: U.S. Travel Association Fall 2025 forecast table; 2026f 2.45B; leisure 1.96B (2025)

us_memorial_day_2026_car_travelers.note: Single holiday weekend, 87% of 45M travelers; used as a hard lower bound for unique US road-trippers

us_unique_adult_road_trippers_per_year.rationale: No sourced count of unique people taking >=1 leisure car trip of 50+ miles per year was found. Must exceed 39.1M on one weekend; 1.96B leisure person-trips/yr implies many repeat trips. 120M is roughly 45% of US adults; test with a survey.

us_inbound_international_visits_2025.note: -5.5% vs 2024; overseas-only 34.3M; 2026f 70.6M. These are visits, not unique persons.

global_international_arrivals_2025.note: +4% YoY; UN Tourism figure cited by Forbes (UN Tourism page returned 403)

long_haul_share_of_heavy_drivers.rationale: No authoritative long-haul/OTR share found in BLS or ATRI releases fetched; 50% is a placeholder.

us_adults_using_ai.note: Menlo Ventures survey of 5,067 US adults, July 2026; daily use 25%

ai_users_paying_for_ai.note: Among AI users (~90M Americans); typical payer spends $20-49/mo

podcast_monthly_12plus.note: 167M Americans 12+; 57% have ever used a gen-AI assistant

freemium_d35_conversion_median.note: Hard paywall 10.7%; all categories (no travel cut)

destination_orgs_destinations_internatio.note: Body text says 575; worldwide membership, not all DMOs

us_rental_new_vehicle_purchases_2025.note: Fleet purchases, not fleet size; US rental revenue $40.6B (2025 proj.)

price_trip_pass.rationale: Below Autio 14-day $14.99 and Narrativ EUR 14.99/3 days

price_driver_monthly.rationale: One third of Trucker Path Diamond $29.99/mo (a utility); companionship is discretionary

price_dmo_annual.rationale: Above SmartGuide EUR 98-780/mo (~EUR 1.2k-9.4k/yr) because we include dynamic coverage + analytics

store_fee_net.note: Apple Small Business Program 15%; Google Play 15% on subscriptions

sam.formula: TAM users x 64% AI users x 55% pay for AI = 42.2M x $39.99

consumer.segment: Inbound international visitors to US (travellers, walking + driving)

somYear3.formula: 0.2% of all visits buy a pass (range 0.1-0.4%)

consumer.note: Not sized: no defensible usage or WTP input. Likely high-engagement, low-WTP; treat as free-tier/retention audience.
Context only: 1.52B international arrivals (2025). Product is global by design but US is the acceptance geography; localization (TTS/LLM quality per language) not yet benchmarked.

b2b.note: Members only; total DMO count (US + global) unknown -> understated. Small market; mainly a distribution channel.

b2b.tamFormula: 1.16M rental vehicles purchased/yr (proxy for fleet) x $1 x 12
b2b.note: Fleet size not sourced; real fleet larger than annual purchases.
Requires evidence that companionship reduces turnover/fatigue; FMCSA hands-free rules apply.

b2b.tamFormula: 16.2M US new light vehicles x $3 one-time
b2b.note: Comparable: Autio in Ford/Lincoln bundled in $14.99/mo connectivity package. Long sales cycles.
Not sized; no sourced count/price input.

summary.caveat: Grossed before store fees (net ~85%). SOM depends on penetration assumptions with no category-specific benchmark; Autio reached 230K registered users (not payers) ~5 years after founding.

contextHeadlines.caveat: Paid syndicated report; methodology not visible; definitions (hardware rental vs apps) unclear. Not used in bottom-up.

contextHeadlines.claim: Consumer AI spend $40B in 2026, up from $12B in 2025; 2B global AI users
contextHeadlines.caveat: VC-authored survey; spend concentrated in power users (14% of payers = 60% of spend).
